details:
ASTRA HEALTH

Astronaut Health Monitoring Platform

DEVELOPED BY: GREEN UNIVERSE (GU)

1. THE CHALLENGE

Green Universe selected the challenge "Create Health Monitoring Software For Astronauts On Space Missions."

Astronauts face several health challenges during spaceflight, especially during long-duration and deep-space missions. Monitoring their health is an important part of supporting crew safety and well-being.

2. OUR SOLUTION

ASTRA HEALTH is a conceptual digital platform designed to organize astronaut health information in one accessible interface.

The platform is organized into six main sections:

01 — OVERVIEW
A centralized dashboard presenting an overview of astronaut health information.

02 — HEALTH INDICATORS
A section for displaying important health metrics.

03 — WELL-BEING
A section focused on astronaut well-being and personal check-ins.

04 — HISTORY
An organized record of previously entered health information.

05 — ALERTS
A proposed notification interface for important health events.

06 — ASTRONAUT PROFILE
A personalized profile containing astronaut information.

3. DEVELOPMENT APPROACH

The project was planned around the needs of astronauts during space missions. Green Universe designed the platform structure, organized its six main sections, and created an interactive visual demonstration of the proposed interface.

4. EXPECTED IMPACT

ASTRA HEALTH aims to make astronaut health information more organized and accessible, supporting health awareness and contributing to the development of future space health monitoring solutions.

5. FUTURE DEVELOPMENT

Future development could include integration with health monitoring sensors, real-time data collection, improved notifications, and additional tools for mission medical teams.

6. CURRENT PROJECT STATUS

ASTRA HEALTH is currently a conceptual project with an interactive visual prototype. It has not yet been implemented as a functional medical monitoring system and does not collect real astronaut health data.
